business_domains.description: This domain manages the product catalog that serves as the foundation for the ordering system. It is responsible for maintaining catalog items with their SKU numbers, descriptions, pricing, inventory levels, and lead times. The domain supports full lifecycle management of catalog entries including creation, retrieval, updating, and removal. It provides the reference data (product definitions and prices) that other domains—especially quoting—depend upon when customers request price quotes for specific items.

This domain manages dealer and supplier information within the ordering system. It is responsible for maintaining dealer profiles including name, contact person, address, email, and phone. The domain supports creating, retrieving, updating, and removing dealer records. Dealers represent the business partners or suppliers associated with customer quotes, and their data is referenced when quotes are created or modified. This domain forms a key reference entity that underpins the quoting process.

This domain handles the creation and management of customer price quotes. A quote aggregates information about a customer, an associated dealer, a validity period, delivery location (city, state, postal code), discount, total cost, and a list of quoted line items (each referencing a catalog item SKU and amount). The domain supports creating new quotes, retrieving quotes by ID or customer name, updating quote details, and deleting quotes. Quotes serve as the precursor to orders—once a quote is approved, it can be converted into an order. This domain bridges customer demand with product catalog and dealer capabilities.

This domain manages the lifecycle of customer orders, which are created from approved quotes. An order tracks the associated quote, order date, and a rich set of lifecycle statuses (Created, Confirmed, Started, Built, DeliveryConfirmed, Shipped, Delivered, Installed). The domain supports creating orders from existing quotes, retrieving orders by ID or dealer, updating order details and status, appending order event comments for audit and tracking purposes, and deleting orders. It also maintains an event log that records activities and comments associated with each order throughout its lifecycle progression.

This domain manages the physical shipment and delivery aspects of fulfilled orders. It is responsible for maintaining shipment records that capture delivery details including delivery date, delivery address (street, city, state, postal code), contact name, and primary and alternate contact phone numbers. The domain supports creating shipment records for orders, retrieving shipments by order status, updating shipment details, appending shipment event information to track the shipment lifecycle, and deleting shipment records. It also provides a consolidated delivery view that aggregates quote, order, and shipment information for a complete delivery picture. The domain interacts closely with the Order domain to validate order existence and status when processing shipments.
